title: Rust: Temperature Converter
description: Convert temperatures between Fahrenheit and Celsius.

steps.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
steps.description: Write a function `c_to_f(c: f64) -> f64` that converts Celsius to Fahrenheit: F = C * 9/5 + 32. Call with 0 and 100, print both.

steps.title: Fahrenheit to Celsius
steps.description: Write a function `f_to_c(f: f64) -> f64` that converts Fahrenheit to Celsius: C = (F - 32) * 5/9. Call with 32 and 212, print both.

steps.title: Converter with Match
steps.description: Write a function `convert(value: f64, unit: char) -> f64` that converts based on unit: 'C' → F, 'F' → C. Print convert(100.0, 'C') and convert(32.0, 'F').

steps.title: Temperature Table
steps.description: Print a conversion table from 0°C to 100°C in steps of 10, showing both °C and °F on each line.
hints: Use a for loop: `for c in (0..=100).step_by(10)`

verification.failureMessage: Print the Celsius to Fahrenheit conversion table.

steps.title: Kelvin Conversion
steps.description: Extend with Kelvin: add `c_to_k(c: f64) -> f64` (K = C + 273.15) and `k_to_c(k: f64) -> f64`. Convert 0°C to Kelvin and 373.15K to Celsius.

verification.failureMessage: Convert 0C to Kelvin and 373.15K to Celsius.
